bug_semantics: CWE-862 missing authorization in the WooCommerce Quick View AJAX handler eael_product_quickview_popup (originally named wp_ajax_eael_product_quickview_popup). The action is registered on both wp_ajax_ and wp_ajax_nopriv_. After a frontend-localized nonce check, it takes attacker-controlled POST product_id, loads that product with wc_get_product()/get_post(), and returns Helper::eael_product_quick_view HTML without testing WooCommerce catalog visibility or post_status. Unauthenticated callers can therefore retrieve title, price, description, and related fields for draft, pending, or private products that the shop loop would not show.
flaw_origin: On 2021-03-07 commit b31258ac7a92efdad52a4c5a0820e404facb1473 (Manzur ahammed, 'added ajax in quickview') converted server-rendered Woo Product Carousel quick view into an AJAX endpoint. Bootstrap.php registered wp_ajax_nopriv_eael_product_quickview_popup, and Traits/Helper.php added a handler that fetched any product_id and rendered it with no is_visible() or publish-status gate. Parent 2ff6c909 already rendered quick view only for products already in the visible loop; the new IDOR surface is this commit. Later rename (f6605d36), 2022 trait extract (88bf8b01/fe82e58), and input sanitization (7701b091) preserved the missing check until the 6.5.6 security patch.

reasoning: CVE-2026-1004 is a published Wordfence CWE-862, not withdrawn. The sink is unauthenticated AJAX eael_product_quickview_popup, which returns WooCommerce product markup for any numeric product_id without visibility or post_status checks. The smallest first-write of that mechanism is b31258ac7a92efdad52a4c5a0820e404facb1473: it added both the nopriv hook and the handler that loads wc_get_product($product_id) and renders the quick-view template. Immediate parent 2ff6c909c8bd85373dc1f785f88b1bdab9993140 exists and has no handler or action name; it only inlined quick view for already-visible loop products. Subsequent rename, trait extract, and sanitization commits are not BICs. The 6.5.6 patch 4e43db06bcf12870cc3b185ed59b3fe2cd227945 is the direct and landing fix (is_visible plus non-admin publish check); it is absent from v6.5.5 and present in v6.5.6. AI attribution is taken only from the BIC commit object, which is a 2021 human author/committer with no AI trailers, so the verdict is NOT_AI.
